entities.summary: Adam Clendening is an American professional ice hockey defenseman who is currently playing for Shanghai Dragons of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Clendening was raised in Wheatfield, New York. He was selected 36th overall by the Chicago Blackhawks in the 2011 NHL entry draft.
